description.p: This is a community package of Hydra Launcher: it repackages the official upstream Debian build unmodified, fetched from upstream's releases at install time.
Hydra Launcher is a gaming platform for managing your game library in one place, from PC games to the classics.

ul.li: Add games you own or any executable, import your Steam library and playtime, and link your Epic Games account
Track playtime and achievements, with cloud saves and a social profile
A built-in download manager with a queue, pause and resume
Hydra Classics: point it at your ROM folders and play through supported emulators
Run Windows games through Proton and UMU

description.p: Games run inside this package's sandbox. Hydra downloads and installs to your Downloads folder by default; other locations need a grant. Starting emulators that are themselves installed as Flatpaks does not work from the sandbox. Updates come through Flatpak; leave Hydra's own automatic install option off.
A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: A game folder outside Downloads: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/games gg.hydralauncher.Hydra
Use the Proton versions installed by Steam: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.steam:ro --filesystem=~/.local/share/Steam:ro gg.hydralauncher.Hydra
Undo all of these: flatpak override --user --reset gg.hydralauncher.Hydra
